_comment: Fixture variables for standalone rendering of state.dart.jinja2 AND state.html.jinja2 (serves both output legs). widget_class_name is the generated class name; file_stem is the lower-snake-case filename stem used to derive the cubit/state import paths; state_type seeds the default variant (loading/empty/error/unavailable/success). empty_icon feeds both legs (html renders it verbatim; state.dart.jinja2 turns it into Icons.<name>) and carries the v1.0 oracle value 'inbox'. The keys empty_title/empty_subtitle/empty_cta_label, error_title/error_message, and skeleton_item_count/skeleton_item_height complete the empty/error/loading contract (the skeleton_* pair also feeds state.css.jinja2's loading branch); tools/tests/test_html_template_renders.py renders every variant in both legs, so dropping one fails loudly. empty_headline/empty_body/error_headline/error_body/error_retry_label remain Dart-leg inputs.
